prompt.en: Which province does Discover Canada call the oldest colony of the British Empire?
prompt.fr: Quelle province Découvrir le Canada présente-t-il comme la plus ancienne colonie de l'Empire britannique?

explanation.en: Newfoundland and Labrador was the oldest colony of the British Empire and an important prize early in Canada's story. Its heritage is closely tied to the sea.
explanation.fr: Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador a été la plus ancienne colonie de l'Empire britannique et un enjeu important au début de l'histoire du Canada. Son patrimoine est étroitement lié à la mer.

source.quote: Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone. In addition to its natural beauty, the province has a unique heritage linked to the sea. The oldest colony of the British Empire and a strategic prize in Canada’s early history
